name: Outlined By A Scythe
source:
A woman is murdered the night before Halloween, and Private Investigator Pamela Edburn is on the case. However, it appears she's bitten off more than she could chew when investigating the strange suspect with a quite stark appearance.

[From [url=https://cringebear.itch.io/outlined-by-a-scythe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
万圣节前夜，一名女子惨遭杀害，私家侦探帕梅拉·埃德伯恩接手调查此案。然而在追查那名外貌极具冲击力的诡异嫌疑人时，她似乎惹上了远超自己应付能力的麻烦。

[摘自[url=https://cringebear.itch.io/outlined-by-a-scythe]itch.io[/url]]
